activity.notes: ATLAS uses 1807 as Gauss's representative Göttingen scholarly milestone year. He left Brunswick and arrived in Göttingen in late 1807 to become director of the observatory; Göttingen then lay within the newly created Kingdom of Westphalia.

sources.title: Carl Friedrich Gauss — MacTutor History of Mathematics
sources.citation_text: MacTutor records that Gauss left Brunswick in 1807 to become director of the Göttingen observatory and arrived in Göttingen late that year.
